name: Custom Contract Manufacturing LLC
old_description: One Stop Custom Cable and Wire Harness assembly and Electric, Mechanical & Electronics Assembly Experts
about:
Based in Hillsboro, Oregon, in the Portland metropolitan area, Custom Contract Manufacturing LLC has been operating for 22 years. The company provides contract manufacturing services without disclosing its founders or ownership structure.

The shop specializes in cable and wire harness assembly, electromechanical and mechanical assembly, box build, battery pack assemblies, conformal coating, switch assemblies, thermocouples, and discrete and ribbon cable fabrication. It also offers engineering support including documentation, fixture design, reverse engineering, wire EDM, and PRO-E CAD design. The company serves customers ranging from individuals needing a few prototypes to organizations requiring tens of thousands of parts per month.

Customers span the United States, with a noted reference from a factory program manager at Intel Corporation. The company does not list specific industry sectors but its capabilities align with electronics, electromechanical, and mechanical manufacturing needs.

Custom Contract Manufacturing emphasizes that no job is too small, offering quick turnarounds, competitive pricing, and a quality system compliant with ISO 9001:2015. Its stated mission is to provide low-cost, high-quality, on-time contract manufacturing services throughout a product's life cycle.
